::: {.project-hook}
At an early-growth investment firm, I studied a practical question: **what makes a deep-tech company investable rather than merely technically impressive?**
:::

## Context

[Tenacity Ventures](https://www.tenacity.vc/){target="_blank"} invests in early-growth, technology-led Indian businesses. During my internship, I researched deep-tech companies in India, prepared a presentation, and produced a project report.

## My contribution

The case study will focus on the work products rather than borrowing the firm’s reputation: how I selected companies, compared technical and commercial signals, organized evidence, and changed my view of what constitutes a defensible investment thesis.
